none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Find an approximate zero of a globally L-Lipschitz operator F from ℝᵈ to ℝᵈ that admits a weak Minty solution. The public input consists of d, L, ρ, σ, R, ε, and x₀. The operator and its solution are hidden.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Each call at an adaptively chosen x returns one vector g(x,ξ) with E[g(x,ξ)] = F(x). Each call uses a fresh independent real-valued seed from the same hidden law, including repeated calls at the same x. Only the vector is returned. The algorithm may use independent internal randomness.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalStochasticWeakMinty.lean, toGeneral and spec.{Query,Reply}. LongTails/Setups/StochasticWeakMinty.lean, spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E‖g(x,ξ)−F(x)‖² ≤ σ², with σ ≥ 0. The sample map is jointly measurable, and both the sample vector and its squared error are integrable at each x.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean ℝᵈ. The parameter regime requires 0 < ε ≤ LR/2¹⁰ and d ≥ (LR/ε)⁶(1 + σ²/ε²).

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: A single zero x⋆ satisfies ‖x⋆−x₀‖ ≤ R and ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩ ≥ −ρ‖F(x)‖² for every x. The parameters satisfy L > 0, R ≥ 0, and 0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1/(20L). The Lipschitz bound applies to the mean operator F.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E‖F(X)‖ ≤ ε, with the first power of the Euclidean norm and expectation over both algorithm and oracle randomness.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return a point X in ℝᵈ whose operator residual ‖F(X)‖ is integrable. The algorithm may compute X from its final state without having queried X.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalStochasticWeakMinty.lean, spec.Output and spec.successful. LongTails/Setups/StochasticWeakMinty.lean, spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm.output and _run.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines a weak Minty condition at one zero with a dimension threshold that grows with the initial radius, noise level, and requested accuracy.
